justification: Both surfaces show human-related imagery on an upright carved slab and both include round disc forms (round shields carried by the warriors in A, plain concentric discs on the body in B) together with elongated weapon-like shapes. But A depicts a narrative composition in two registers, a row of armed standing figures above a mounted rider trampling a serpentine creature inside a patterned arched frame, whereas B is a single schematic anthropomorphic statue-stele whose whole body surface carries isolated geometric emblems, with no scene, no framing border and no interaction between figures.
